svg.aria-label: Side-on, one edge of the blade between the shared pairs 2 and 4. At morph = 0, pair 3 sits on the curve, which bulges away from the straight segment. At morph = 1 it sits on the straight segment from 2 to 4, at the same fraction of the way from 2 to 4.
svg.title: Side-on, one edge of the blade between the shared pairs 2 and 4. At morph = 0, pair 3 sits on the curve, which bulges away from the straight segment. At morph = 1 it sits on the straight segment from 2 to 4, at the same fraction of the way from 2 to 4.
